continuity.campaign_development: June 60 BCE: Valerius continued acquiring neglected estates as restoration projects, refused an exploitative distressed sale, restored fields and infrastructure, and received a voluntary offer for a neighboring estate that remained under negotiation. Treasury fell to 1880 from restoration expenditure; agriculture rose to 79, relations to 100, and holdings to 4.25 square miles.
continuity.land_area_history: 4.25 square miles after a 0.25 square mile increase from completed restoration-oriented estate purchases.
